From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Anthemia Health — Private deployment orchestration & install window

Hi Alice / Anthemia DevOps team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Private. We're scheduled to begin the deployment work in the week of Aug 7. To make the onboarding smooth we need a couple of confirmations from your side before we lock the install window: 

1) VPC ranges and preferred peer CIDRs (please share in CIDR format).
2) Public IP blocks for the customer-edge NAT (if you plan to NAT egress).
3) Internal contact(s) for on-prem appliance installation and an on-site availability window (if applicable).
4) Any procurement or maintenance blackout dates in August.

Attachments: anthemia_vpc_ranges.csv (please fill), redwood_private_install-checklist.pdf (Redwood preflight checklist)

Proposed next steps: once we have the CIDRs and on-site point of contact, I'll introduce our implementation lead (Monica) and schedule a 60-min networking review + install-runbook walkthrough.

If Aug 7–9 is tight for you, suggest alternative windows Aug 14–16.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@anthemiahealth.com>

Cc: Martin Liu <martin.liu@anthemiahealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@anthemiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anthemia Health — Private deployment orchestration & install window

Hi Ben,

Thanks — confirming we can target Aug 14–16 as our preferred install window. A few notes from our side:

- Attached is the filled CIDR spreadsheet (anthemia_vpc_ranges.csv). Primary VPC: 10.4.0.0/16.
- We do NAT egress via two public IPs: 52.23.44.11, 52.23.44.12.
- On-prem appliance will be installed by Martin Liu (CC'd) — Martin will be on-site Aug 14 morning. 
- We have a maintenance blackout Aug 7–9, so the earlier window won't work.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will need inbound firewall rules from our management subnet (10.128.0.0/20) to the private endpoint? If so, we'll open a change request prior to the install.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Infrastructure, Anthemia Health
alice.chen@anthemiahealth.com

Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Anthemia Health — Private deployment orchestration & install window

Team — forwarding Anthemia's confirmation and filled CIDR sheet. Quick handoff:

Scope highlights
- Private deployment (VPC peering + private endpoint) to be staged Aug 14–16.
- On-prem appliance install Aug 14 morning (Martin on-site).
- Public egress IPs provided for NAT. Anthemia likely will open management subnet to our control-plane for onboarding (Alice asked about inbound rules).

Action items (owners/ETA):
- Monica: lead implementation runbook, coordinate canary routing and test prompts during the 14–15 acceptance window. Please prepare appliance install checklist and remote support plan. (ETA: July 24 to share initial runbook).
- Vivek: validate kernel/quantization profile recommendations for their workload; flag any potential model fallbacks for resource-constrained nodes. (ETA: July 26).
- Priyom: create a networking change request template for Anthemia's firewall team and confirm expected ports and IPs. (ETA: July 20).
- Laura: prepare SRE contact escalation matrix and provide SLA handover notes. (ETA: July 25).

Alice / Martin: expect an internal runbook and a short pre-install networking review meeting proposal (45 min) by next Monday. Please share a preferred time slot for the networking review (Mon/Tue mornings PT).

Ben

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Anthemia Health — Private deployment orchestration & install window

Thanks Ben. Quick update from networking:

- I reviewed the attached CIDR sheet. Primary VPC (10.4.0.0/16) is fine. We recommend reserving 10.4.250.0/24 for the appliance management network to avoid conflicts with Anthemia subnets.
- Required ports for private endpoint and management plane:
  - TCP 443 (HTTPS) outbound from appliance to Redwood control-plane IPs
  - TCP 22 (SSH) restricted to our install window IPs for initial provisioning (close after install)
  - UDP 123 (NTP) outbound to public NTP pools
- For VPC peering (if peering rather than transit), route table changes will be needed on both sides; I'll attach a change request template.

Attachments: runbook_stub.md, networking-change-request-template.docx

Proposed timeline:
- Jul 20: I will share the firewall change request template and explicit port/IP list (Alice, please use this for your change ticket).
- Jul 24: Monica circulates final runbook.
- Aug 13 (14:00 PT): 45-min pre-install networking review (confirming NAT, peer routing, and firewall rules).

I'll also call out edge cases: if their on-prem network has overlapping routes with 10.4.0.0/16 we'll need either NAT on their side or pick a different appliance management range.

- Priyom
Senior Network Architect — Redwood Inference
